title: Deme Acres Golf Course
specs: 18-hole, Par 70 course with wide fairways and evergreen trees
Front nine is shorter and tight with tall white pine and spruce trees
Back nine is longer and more open with challenging holes
Discounts available for juniors, groups, and military
Anyone is welcome to play in local fundraisers and outings; signup forms available in clubhouse

blurb: Deme Acres Golf Course is an 18-hole, Par 70 course open to the public daily. The front nine is shorter and tighter with tall trees lining each hole, while the back nine is longer and more open. The course features a variety of holes including par 3s, 4s, and 5s with natural hazards like sand traps, water, and trees.
